title: BLES01658
scope: Logs supplied by the maintainer after installing private 559. Restore traces are builds 547/553 and the 553 timeline part is Bladestorm BLES00113; neither describes the 559 DBZ process.

interpretation.readbacks: Every READBACK555 batch in session 2 transfers one 1280x720 32-bit section (3,686,400 bytes); all are attributed to origin unknown.
interpretation.rsx_waits: RSX texture-site fence waits (cleanup_after_dma_transfers on the primary buffer) are one fewer per frame than readback batches in every window.
interpretation.code_path_hypothesis: With Write Color Buffers off, VKGSRender::prepare_rtts commits each bound framebuffer (committed_as_fbo). That cause does not skip flushes, so a GPU-resident framebuffer_storage section starting at the framebuffer address (a blit target, protected regardless of WCB) is read back synchronously on the RSX thread: one wait per frame in light scenes, two in battles. The remaining readback per frame has no RSX wait: the guest CPU fault path on the secondary buffer.
interpretation.not_proven_by_logs: The logs carry no origin for these batches; the 560 Core attributes them (fbo_commit, fault_read, fault_write) and counts the deferrals.
interpretation.opt559: OPT559 counters are zero in every window: none of the 559 paths is on this path.
